name: xmltodict-single-comment-roundtrip
rationale: xmltodict 1.0.4 documents process_comments and comment roundtripping; upstream tests/test_dicttoxml.py::test_comment_roundtrip_limited asserts preserved element-level comment content. XML 1.0 sections 2.4 and 2.5 allow literal &, < and > in comments, and entity references are not interpreted in comments. A single nonempty element-level comment avoids the documented multiple-top-level-comment ordering limitation. Parse uses process_comments=True and strip_whitespace=False. The adapter only wraps and unwraps the public APIs.
domain: One nonempty XML comment of length 1 through 64 from the explicit XML-legal alphabet in strategy. There is one fixed root element and one comment, with no mixed character data, attributes, namespaces, child elements or top-level comments. Hyphen is excluded to make -- and trailing - impossible. CR, illegal XML controls, surrogates and empty comments are excluded; whitespace preservation is explicitly enabled.
